Evening rules for the planning crew
This section explains the steps that matter

Companion Animal Travel Desk evening procedures

This section sets the standard for calm handling, accurate checks, and prompt handoff of companion animal travel cases. Staff must confirm booking details, review carrier condition, and keep passenger communication clear and courteous. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and every animal receives patient attention from trained staff. <<FACT F082>> Records must show that the traveler presented the required papers before acceptance, and any gap in documentation must be escalated without delay.

For kennel and cabin review, staff must inspect ventilation, secure latches, absorbent lining, and clean placement. <<FACT F065>> If the pet or crate fails inspection, the case must pause until the issue is corrected. The desk must also verify water access, label accuracy, and any handling notes that affect transfer, loading, or rest stops. When doubt remains, staff must choose the safer course and keep the passenger informed in plain language.

Report exceptions, medical concerns, and schedule conflicts to the senior coordinator at once.
